sources.claim: Replit remains PM, planner and designer; external agents own architecture and code.
sources.acceptance: Apply as this package responsibility contract.
sources.limit: Does not grant spending or platform capabilities.

sources.claim: Root replit.md provides project context to Agent.
sources.acceptance: Use a scoped guidance/receipt reference for future conversations.
sources.limit: Reject inference that context is a task database or enforced queue lock.

sources.claim: Instructions guide behavior, without guaranteed strict enforcement.
sources.acceptance: Keep policy guidance distinct from actual coordination controls.
sources.limit: No claim that a current Agent reloads a changed instruction immediately.

sources.authority: official vendor documentation reviewed earlier in this session
sources.claim: Native task lifecycle includes queued, active, ready, applying and Done dispositions.
sources.acceptance: Require actual current-state and effect checks.
sources.limit: A later refresh returned a retrieval error; do not claim fresh re-verification of that page in the improvement loop.

sources.claim: Reviewed external tools cover app operations; no direct external task-completion capability was established.
sources.acceptance: Discover supported capabilities at the time of action.
sources.limit: Absence from this review is not proof such a capability can never exist.

sources.authority: authenticated owner-session observations, private underlying records
sources.claim: Sampled native completion appeared in history without replit.md changes; inspected Shell CLI exposed no completion command.
sources.acceptance: Distinguish native tool history from external invocation.
sources.limit: Underlying private transcripts and UI captures are excluded; another operator cannot reproduce them from the package alone.

sources.authority: historical v0.1.0 exercise in the owner session
sources.claim: Source recovery and plan preservation succeeded; unfinished plans did not complete an external-to-native board cycle.
sources.acceptance: Convert gaps into development cases and retain draftable maturity.
sources.limit: Not current-version live performance or quantified savings.

claim_ledger.claim: The revised contract retains Replit planning/design while routing architecture/code externally.
claim_ledger.consequence: Wrong executor or lost design intent.

claim_ledger.claim: A receipt or context edit alone is not verified native board completion.
claim_ledger.next_test: Recheck declared capability and observed state for one authorized return.

claim_ledger.claim: A bounded native administrative return might close the workflow if supported effects and ownership can be established.
claim_ledger.consequence: Queue wakeup, duplicate apply, or unapproved usage.
claim_ledger.next_test: One supervised supported trial with observed before/after effects.

claim_ledger.claim: The revised skill reduces actual spend or achieves validated cross-host execution.
claim_ledger.next_test: Matched comparable runs with telemetry, current-version end-to-end pilot and unseen holdout.
